description: Render an SVG to a PNG asset on disk via Image.load_svg_from_buffer. The SVG is rendered directly from bytes — no temp file is created, so concurrent calls are safe and project-rename quirks (user:// rebinding) cannot break it. Returns resource_path, absolute_path, dimensions {width,height}, and the render_scale used.

height.description: Optional desired output height in pixels. Same as width but matched on the height axis. If both width and height are provided, width takes precedence for scale derivation.

save_path.description: Destination directory (default: res://assets/generated/). Created if it does not exist.

scale.description: Optional explicit render scale (e.g. 2.0 = 2x). Overrides width/height-derived scaling. Default: 1.0.

svg_code.description: Complete SVG markup. Either single or double quotes are accepted in attributes.

width.description: Optional desired output width in pixels. Combined with the SVG's intrinsic width to derive a uniform render_scale.

name: generate_2d_asset
